caption: A gymnast lands feet-first in the centre of a trampoline, the mat stretches deep under her, and it throws her back up into the air.

sa.check: A gymnast comes down onto a trampoline.
She lands feet-first in the centre.
The mat stretches deep under her.
She is thrown back up into the air.
The landing comes first, then the dip, then the rebound.

pc.expect: The mat dips as she lands and springs back as she rises, and she leaves it as it returns to flat.
pc.fail: The mat stays rigid like a floor; or it stays stretched after she leaves; or it ripples like water.

pc.expect: The rebound follows the dip, upward, roughly along the line she came down.
pc.fail: She is thrown sideways off the trampoline; or she rises before the mat has dipped; or she stops dead on the mat with no rebound.

pc.expect: She comes down, then goes up, slowing as she rises.
pc.fail: She hangs at the bottom of the dip; or hangs at the top; or speeds up after leaving the mat.

pc.expect: The springs and frame hold and the trampoline stays put.
pc.fail: The frame lifts off the ground; or it slides; or the mat moves before she lands.

pc.expect: One gymnast keeps her limbs and shape, and she does not pass through the mat.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or she passes through the mat; or a second figure appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Her leotard, the trampoline and the gym stay the same.
pc.fail: The leotard changes colour; or the trampoline changes; or the gym rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the gymnast is kept because her body is the load. Form and technique are not judged.
